other_conditions: Must have actively participated and struggled during the emergency period (25‑06‑1975 to 21‑03‑1977) and have been imprisoned for any duration under the MISA Act, 1971 and/or the Defence of India Act, 1962
Widows of such persons are also eligible
Beneficiary must be a resident of Haryana (or a person domiciled in another state who was arrested and jailed in Haryana)

Must produce a jail certificate issued by the Jail Superintendent and countersigned by the District Magistrate, or if unavailable, a certificate from two co‑prisoners authenticated by an MLA or MP of the concerned district
Must open an Aadhaar‑linked savings bank account in any nationalised bank and provide a yearly “live certificate” in January
If the beneficiary dies, the monthly pension continues to the surviving spouse
Applicant can apply from only one district and must submit an affidavit confirming no application has been made in any other district
If receiving a pension from another State Government for the same purpose, the amount received will be deducted from the ₹10,000 pension (except for old‑age pension)
benefits_summary: Eligible emergency sufferers receive a monthly pension of ₹10,000.
documents_required: Jail certificate issued by the Jail Superintendent and countersigned by the District Magistrate
Certificate from two co‑prisoners authenticated by an MLA or MP (if jail certificate is unavailable)
Affidavit confirming the applicant has not applied from any other district
Proof of Aadhaar‑linked savings bank account (bank account details)
